convert.empty.body.en: PDF, Word, PowerPoint, Excel, images, web pages and more become Markdown in {folder}.
convert.empty.body.zh-Hans: PDF、Word、PowerPoint、Excel、图片、网页等都会转成 Markdown，保存到 {folder}。

convert.url.invalid.en: Enter a web address that starts with http:// or https://.
convert.url.invalid.zh-Hans: 请输入以 http:// 或 https:// 开头的网址。

convert.remove.busy.en: A conversion can't be stopped once it starts.

notice.folder.en: “{name}” is a folder. Add the files inside it instead.
notice.folder.zh-Hans: “{name}”是文件夹。请添加其中的文件。

notice.folders.en: {count} folders weren't added. Add the files inside them instead.
notice.folders.zh-Hans: {count} 个文件夹未添加。请添加其中的文件。

detail.empty.en: Select a conversion to see its Markdown.
detail.empty.zh-Hans: 选择一个转换以查看 Markdown。

detail.queued.en: Waiting for a free slot. Markitai converts two files at a time.
detail.queued.zh-Hans: 正在等待空位。Markitai 每次同时转换两个文件。

detail.converting.note.en: A conversion can't be stopped once it starts. Quitting now loses its result.
detail.converting.note.zh-Hans: 转换开始后无法停止。现在退出会丢失结果。

detail.show.windows.zh-Hans: 在文件资源管理器中显示

detail.missing.body.en: It is no longer at {path}. It may have been moved or deleted.
detail.missing.body.zh-Hans: 它已不在 {path}，可能已被移动或删除。

history.empty.body.en: Finished conversions appear here. Removing an entry keeps its files.
history.empty.body.zh-Hans: 完成的转换会显示在这里。移除记录不会删除文件。

history.clear.body.en: Your converted files stay in the output folder.
history.clear.body.zh-Hans: 转换后的文件仍保留在输出文件夹中。

history.reset.en: History couldn't be read, so Markitai started a new one. The old file is kept as {name}.
history.reset.zh-Hans: 无法读取历史记录，已重新开始。旧文件保留为 {name}。

settings.llm.note.en: A model from your markitai configuration tidies the Markdown. Providers may charge for requests.
settings.llm.note.zh-Hans: 由 markitai 配置中的模型整理 Markdown。服务商可能按请求收费。

settings.ocr.note.en: Reads scans and images on this computer with the OCR settings in your markitai configuration. The first use downloads its models.
settings.ocr.note.zh-Hans: 按 markitai 配置中的 OCR 设置在本机识别扫描件和图片。首次使用会下载模型。

settings.screenshot.note.en: Saves an image of each page. Office files need LibreOffice. Web pages need Chrome or Chromium.
settings.screenshot.note.zh-Hans: 保存每一页的图像。Office 文件需要 LibreOffice，网页需要 Chrome 或 Chromium。

settings.desc.note.en: A vision model from your markitai configuration describes each image. Needs Enhance with AI.
settings.desc.note.zh-Hans: 由 markitai 配置中的视觉模型描述每张图片。需要开启 AI 增强。

settings.alt.note.en: A vision model from your markitai configuration writes alt text for each image. Needs Enhance with AI.
settings.alt.note.zh-Hans: 由 markitai 配置中的视觉模型为每张图片写替代文本。需要开启 AI 增强。

settings.output.note.en: Each conversion gets its own folder here.
settings.output.note.zh-Hans: 每次转换都会在这里新建一个文件夹。

settings.output.unwritable.en: Markitai can't write to that folder. Choose another one.
settings.output.unwritable.zh-Hans: Markitai 无法写入该文件夹，请另选一个。

settings.config.user.zh-Hans: 使用我的 markitai 配置

settings.config.user.missing.en: No configuration file yet. Built-in defaults apply until you create one.
settings.config.user.missing.zh-Hans: 还没有配置文件。创建之前使用内置默认值。

settings.config.builtin.note.en: Ignores configuration files. MODEL and provider keys in your environment still apply.
settings.config.builtin.note.zh-Hans: 忽略配置文件。环境中的 MODEL 和服务商密钥仍然有效。

quit.body.one.en: 1 conversion is still running. If you quit now, it stops and its result is lost.
quit.body.one.zh-Hans: 还有 1 个转换正在进行。现在退出会中止它，结果将丢失。

quit.body.other.en: {count} conversions are still running. If you quit now, they stop and their results are lost.
quit.body.other.zh-Hans: 还有 {count} 个转换正在进行。现在退出会中止它们，结果将丢失。

quit.body.queued.en: Files waiting in the queue are not converted.
quit.body.queued.zh-Hans: 排队中的文件也不会被转换。

error.not_found.en: The file is no longer there. It may have been moved or deleted.
error.not_found.zh-Hans: 文件已不在原处，可能已被移动或删除。

error.is_directory.en: This is a folder. Add the files inside it instead.
error.is_directory.zh-Hans: 这是文件夹。请添加其中的文件。

error.no_model_configured.en: Enhance with AI needs a model. Add one to your markitai configuration, or turn off Enhance with AI.
error.no_model_configured.zh-Hans: AI 增强需要模型。请在 markitai 配置中添加模型，或关闭 AI 增强。

error.unsupported.en: Markitai can't convert this kind of file.
error.unsupported.zh-Hans: Markitai 无法转换此类文件。

error.conversion_error.en: The document couldn't be converted. Check that it opens in its own app.
error.conversion_error.zh-Hans: 无法转换此文档。请确认它能在原应用中正常打开。

error.fetch_error.en: Couldn't download this page. Check the address and your internet connection.
error.fetch_error.zh-Hans: 无法下载此网页。请检查网址和网络连接。

error.config_error.en: Your markitai configuration has a problem.

error.io_error.en: Markitai couldn't read or write a file. Check that the output folder exists, can be written and has free space.
error.io_error.zh-Hans: Markitai 无法读写文件。请确认输出文件夹存在、可写入且空间充足。

error.output_unavailable.en: Markitai couldn't create a folder in {folder}. Choose another output folder in {settings}.
error.output_unavailable.zh-Hans: 无法在 {folder} 中创建文件夹。请在{settings}中另选输出文件夹。

error.image_only.en: This image has no text layer. Turn on OCR or Enhance with AI in {settings} to read its text.
error.image_only.zh-Hans: 这张图片没有文字层。请在{settings}中开启 OCR 或 AI 增强以识别其中的文字。

error.internal.en: Markitai hit an internal error. Retry, and report the details if it happens again.
error.internal.zh-Hans: Markitai 遇到内部错误。请重试；如再次出现，请报告详细信息。

preview.webview2_missing.en: The preview needs the Microsoft Edge WebView2 Runtime. The Markdown tab still works.
preview.webview2_missing.zh-Hans: 预览需要 Microsoft Edge WebView2 运行时。Markdown 标签页仍可使用。

preview.unavailable.en: The preview can't be shown on this computer. The Markdown tab still works.
preview.unavailable.zh-Hans: 此电脑无法显示预览。Markdown 标签页仍可使用。

preview.failed.en: The preview couldn't be shown. The Markdown tab still works.
preview.failed.zh-Hans: 无法显示预览。Markdown 标签页仍可使用。

fatal.abi.title.en: This copy of Markitai is incomplete

fatal.abi.body.en: Its conversion library doesn't match the app. Reinstall Markitai.
fatal.abi.body.zh-Hans: 它的转换库与应用不匹配。请重新安装 Markitai。

a11y.drop_zone.en: Drop files or web links here to convert them.
a11y.drop_zone.zh-Hans: 将文件或网页链接拖到这里进行转换。

plist.documents.en: Markitai saves converted Markdown in your Documents folder.
plist.documents.zh-Hans: Markitai 会把转换后的 Markdown 保存到“文稿”文件夹。

plist.desktop.en: Markitai reads the files you add from your Desktop.
plist.desktop.zh-Hans: Markitai 会读取你从桌面添加的文件。

plist.downloads.en: Markitai reads the files you add from your Downloads folder.
plist.downloads.zh-Hans: Markitai 会读取你从“下载”文件夹添加的文件。
